receiptQualifications.target: LSC-2 admission test inventory LS13 ("bad stored value falls back to primary")
receiptQualifications.qualification: LS13 pins that a bad stored choice is never used, not that it falls back to primary. The frozen store throws INVALID_CHOICE with "Forget it and choose again"; the chooser is disabled with that message, a join refuses with the same message and mints nothing (pinned by the join test added after review), and "Forget next-join choice" returns the choice to primary. A silent display or mint fallback would substitute the primary GM identity for a profile that chose a seat. Reviewer ruling: acceptable, no admission amendment needed; record as a qualification at closure.

The RED receipt rawLog embeds a one-byte newline instead of the status lines (redReceiptRawLogDefect in the local receipt). The RED receipt is byte-frozen and unedited; the full RED log is outside Git with the sha256 the local receipt records, and the reviewer re-ran RED (51 failed / 29 passed, 80/80 statuses matching).

carryForwards.target: LSC-2P packaged journey record; CampaignCoopEntryPanel.tsx and CoopCredentialRenewal (LS16 is frozen)
carryForwards.status: open gap (review F6); fails closed, not a security issue
carryForwards.item: At entry, the IDENTITY_CHANGED message says to forget the sign-in and reclaim through co-op entry, but the only per-match forget control is inside CoopCredentialRenewal, which renders nothing while the bearer has more than four minutes left. In the same tab a user who rejoins a match with a different credential has no reachable forget until the window opens (workaround: a new tab). LSC-2P records the journey consequence; a fix needs a registered owner.
